seo.description: DiArsanima (DiA), multidisciplinary visual artist from Maribor: painting, digital art and murals.

blocks.body:
Welcome to the artistic landscape of DiArsanima!

Or *DiA* for short.

I'm a multidisciplinary visual artist whose main objective is to build my own menagerie of archetypes, which are created with traditional or digital techniques and share them with the world. Join me in digging deep into our collective human psyche and explore the symbols which I integrate into predominantly portraits of imagined or real women, that encompass traits of our ancestors, rituals, big and small stories. My artwork is a result of lifelong study of human experience on symbolic level through combining myth with contemporary reality through the *fierce divine feminine.*
